llm._comment_local: think:false via native Ollama API. Low num_predict for voice speed.

vision._comment: Fast mode: structural glance (window titles) by default. VLM only for explicit look/describe/computer-use fallback. Sticky monitor focus via look-at-monitor-N.

stt._comment: Free self-hosted OpenAI Whisper from github.com/openai/whisper (model turbo on CUDA). No paid API.

auto_learn._comment: When an app opens or becomes focused, scan its UI and save how-to knowledge. Vision/OCR runs when UIA finds few controls.
